outer-border.order: After wings, before crest and badge

wing_attachment.note: Border variants translate each wing outward separately; they retain the original pixels and canvas.

wide_concept.note: Wide badge concept; overlay live text. Its proportions need their own ornament positions.

notes: All layers share a 2048 × 2048 transparent canvas.
Badge pixels are retained at their original size; new accessories are scaled into place.
Six independently selectable ornament styles each support milestones 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50.
Small wings and ascendant wings are separate designs; the superseded old full wings remain retired.
Every plate marker and title is measured and centered within the plate's safe text area.
Podium awards are independent of progression styles.
Champion uses a central crown and exclusive gold laurels; no placement numeral 1.
